translation.explore.scoreInfo.title: Score information
translation.explore.scoreInfo.redundancyCalculation: For each underlying security, we add its portfolio-weighted exposure across the selected ETFs and subtract its largest contribution from any one ETF. The remainder is counted as redundant exposure.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.redundancyExample: For example, if two ETFs with identical holdings are allocated 70% and 30%, the smaller ETF contributes 30% redundant exposure.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.redundancyUnavailable: The score is unavailable if an ETF with a positive allocation has no usable holdings.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.pairwiseCalculation: Each cell compares the two ETFs named by its row and column. For each shared underlying security or company, overlap includes the smaller disclosed weight. A 6% holding in one ETF and 4% in the other adds 4 percentage points.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.pairwiseHoldings: The bars show both ETFs' disclosed weights for the shared companies with the largest overlap contributions, up to the developer-set maximum (default 20). A company's smaller weight contributes to overlap. Undisplayed shared holdings are not listed; their combined overlap contribution is shown in the footer.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.pairwiseCoverage: Disclosed weights are not scaled to 100% when holdings are incomplete. Coverage is shown for each ETF.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.pairwiseUnavailable: N/A means the pair could not be compared; it does not mean zero overlap.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.diversificationCalcula: HHI stands for Herfindahl-Hirschman Index. We normalize disclosed company weights to 100%, square each company’s share, and add those values to calculate HHI. The score is the inverse of HHI.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.diversificationEffecti: This is an effective number of equally weighted companies, not the actual number of companies held. A score of 10 means the disclosed exposure has the same concentration as 10 equally weighted companies.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.diversificationRatings: Ratings: below 5, Highly Concentrated; 5 to below 10, Concentrated; 10 to below 20, Moderately Diversified; 20 to below 40, Well Diversified; 40 or more, Highly Diversified.
translation.explore.scoreInfo.diversificationCoverag: When holdings are incomplete, the calculation uses disclosed company exposure. The coverage warning shows how much is included.
